summary: Test tooling only: st-test's pool-tree queue follows main's current rules for every waiter. A run waiting for a tree continues in main's newer scripts/st-test when it changes (in the same process, keeping its ticket and place), and tickets carry the version of the rules they follow so a waiter defers only to its own rules or newer; a run that kept an older copy waited 13.2 h because each version deferred to the other

replay.detail: Test tooling change only; no replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes. What a note names and how the gate judges it are unchanged: the handover happens only before a tree is held.

compatibility.detail: Waiters on copies older than this keep their rules until they get a tree; their tickets get no deference from new waiters, and the tree's flock decides between them.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
